exploration_boundary.policy: Use this indoor wall/fence boundary for the next Factory exploration gates. Do not command exploration outside it unless the user explicitly reopens outdoor/exterior exploration.

z_policy.reason: The accepted low-floor component is near world z=0. Use a fixed altitude band for first Factory exploration so vertical excursions do not hide planner/control defects.
z_policy.promotion_rule: Only promote terrain-aware or free-Z exploration after a source audit shows material floor-height variation inside the selected runtime boundary and a bounded single-UAV gate passes.

runtime_expansion_policy.full_map_definition: Boundary-limited exploration inside the user-accepted indoor wall/fence envelope. Outdoor/exterior Factory space is out of scope until explicitly reopened.
runtime_expansion_policy.z_failure_policy: If runtime evidence shows terrain or floor-height variation invalidates the fixed z band, stop for a source-geometry height audit instead of widening z or allowing free-z exploration.

first_capacity_gate.purpose: Check whether accumulated point cloud and occupancy review can run without caps over a bounded duration.

single_uav_fuel.expand_after_pass: The complete indoor fixed map passed the short gate. Extend execution duration only while planning time, CPU, safety, and coverage growth remain within gates; use rolling-window migration only after a demonstrated source-level expansion blocker.

fixed_goal_regression.single_uav: Diff-Planner Factory fixed-goal regression after exploration source gate is stable
fixed_goal_regression.multi_uav: Diff-Planner three-UAV Factory fixed-goal regression after single fixed-goal pass

latest_runtime_evidence.boundary_check: truth/odom/position_cmd/planner_position_cmd_raw XY samples stayed inside the wall-center indoor boundary
latest_runtime_evidence.coverage_scope: local around indoor center only; truth span about 8.3m x 5.9m and planner command span about 10.5m x 5.9m, not full 175.7m x 64.0m indoor boundary coverage
risk_notes: exploration phase peak roll/pitch reached about 40deg in metrics and should be visually reviewed before longer runs
review accumulation quality gate skipped late landing samples because odom_z fell below 0.85m; this is expected during landing and not planner input
latest_runtime_evidence.next_step: Do RViz/UE visual audit or design a bounded indoor coverage sweep before claiming full indoor exploration.

latest_coverage_attempt.boundary_check: truth/odom/position_cmd/planner_position_cmd_raw XY samples stayed inside the wall-center indoor boundary
latest_coverage_attempt.coverage_scope: truth span about 9.8m x 9.6m and planner command span about 9.9m x 12.4m, still far below the 175.7m x 64.0m indoor boundary
risk_notes: exploration phase peak roll/pitch reached about 43deg in metrics
single center-start RACER does not naturally expand to full indoor coverage within this bounded run
latest_coverage_attempt.next_step: Use tile/multi-start RACER or three-UAV RACER coverage over the accepted indoor boundary; do not claim full indoor coverage from this local run.

latest_fuel_local_first_coverage.decision: Do not keep extending local-first FUEL duration as the main experiment. Reopen FUEL only through rolling-window or tile coverage strategy with merged coverage accounting.

latest_fuel_mid360_fixed_map_gate.planner: FUEL single-UAV unknown exploration with FAST-LIO MID360 frontend
latest_fuel_mid360_fixed_map_gate.decision: The complete fixed map and MID360 frontend are executable. The previous apparent stop was the bounded execute timeout, not FUEL FINISH. Run a bounded long-duration growth gate before any full-coverage claim or rolling-window redesign.

minimum_runtime_metrics: all UAV truth/odom XY stay inside exploration_boundary with tolerance
truth and odom Z stay inside z_policy min/max with tolerance
accumulated point cloud and occupancy counts increase during exploration
runtime logs contain no fatal Gazebo/PX4/MAVROS/planner errors
RViz/UE review is opened only after backend metrics pass
claim_boundary: This file is a source/static envelope contract plus runtime expansion policy.
It is not runtime proof of full-map exploration.
It does not grant FUEL/RACER prior access to the static world mesh.
Gazebo/PX4/MAVROS/RViz/log metrics remain runtime authority; UE remains display/review.
